diagnostics.h2: Know what every referrer earns. Get reports out faster.
diagnostics.body: Track referrer commissions automatically on every bill, tag and barcode every sample from collection to delivery, verify results with quality control before release, and hand patients their reports faster, across every branch, on one system. Corporate and credit accounts handled.
hospitals.h2: One system for your whole hospital.
hospitals.body: Admissions and wards, OT and emergency, pharmacy and inventory, billing and credit accounts, clinical records, workforce and analytics, all on one platform built for Bangladesh, with an append-only audit trail on every sensitive action.

appointments.b4.p: Your list, your serials and your no-shows, wherever you are.

data.h2: Your patients' data stays in Bangladesh, and every sensitive action is on the record.
data.body: Held on servers in Bangladesh, in line with the country's data-protection rules, plus an append-only audit trail that even the owner cannot edit.
ledger.note: Append-only. Even the owner cannot edit a line.

pricing.h2: Free to start. Priced per facility when you grow.
pricing.r2.p: It costs less than three patients a month.
pricing.r3.p: Priced per facility, with founder pricing for the early cohort. Book a demo for a quote scoped to your centre or hospital.
faq.q1: Is this a full hospital system or just appointments?
faq.a1: Appointments is live now. The rest of the platform is in early access and rolls out with the founding cohort. Book a demo and we set the timeline with you.
faq.q2: Is it built for diagnostic centres specifically?
faq.a2: Yes. Referrer earnings on every bill, barcoded samples from collection to delivery, verification before release, and fast report delivery are the core of the diagnostics tier.
faq.q3: Why not a cheaper chamber tool?
faq.a3: A chamber tool runs one desk. LofiCare runs the whole facility on one record, and the appointment module is the first step of it, not a separate app.
faq.a4: It stays in Bangladesh, and every sensitive action is written to an append-only audit trail that nobody, including the owner, can edit.
faq.q5: How long does it take to get started?
faq.a5: Appointments today. The platform on a timeline we set together after the demo.
faq.q6: Can I try it before I commit?
faq.a6: Yes. Start free on appointments with your first 500 bookings and no card.

hospitals.dept.1.desc: Admit from the emergency desk or the OPD, assign a bed and attach the stay to the same patient record the lab and pharmacy already use.
hospitals.dept.2.desc: Bed board by ward, nursing notes, doctor rounds and transfers, with every order visible at the counter as it happens.
hospitals.dept.3.desc: Theatre scheduling, surgeon and anaesthesia notes, and consumables charged to the admission the moment they are used.
hospitals.dept.4.desc: Triage first, paperwork second. A patient is registered in seconds and everything that follows is already on their file.
hospitals.dept.5.desc: Indoor and outdoor dispensing against the prescription, stock by batch and expiry, reorder before the shelf runs empty.
hospitals.dept.6.desc: One running bill per admission across ward, OT, pharmacy and lab, with corporate, insurance and health card accounts settled at discharge.
hospitals.dept.7.desc: Clinical notes, prescriptions and digital forms on one timeline per patient, kept with an append-only audit trail.
hospitals.dept.8.desc: Duty rosters, attendance and access by role, so every action in the system carries a name.
